neighbours.label: 'head' (and face/cheek) as a physical body part being placed or covered
fire: The tired child laid her head on the pillow and slept.
He ducked his head under the low doorway.
The turtle pulled its head back into its shell.
She wrapped a scarf around her head against the wind.
The baby rested his head against his mother's chest.
He scratched his head while reading the letter.
The dog tilted its head when it heard the whistle.
Keep your head down when you swing the club.
quiet: The tired child laid her book on the pillow and slept.
He ducked his shoulder under the low doorway.
The turtle pulled its legs back into its shell.
She wrapped a scarf around her waist against the wind.
The new head of sales rested after a long meeting.
He scratched his arm while reading the letter.
The dog tilted its bowl when it heard the whistle.
Keep your feet apart when you swing the club.

notes: Card: ' head' x15 of top 32, plus neck, face, cheek, kissed. Probe: body-part head 0.49-0.53, 'head of the department' 0.03, hand 0.06. The - pole is teeth/dentistry.
